name: tusks-vault
description: Tusk's Vault — a locally-hosted fantasy-scribe AI that grounds D&D lore answers in your campaign documents.

overrides: pdf-parse pins @napi-rs/canvas to exactly 0.1.80, and 0.1.80 publishes no
win32-arm64-msvc build. Windows on ARM therefore resolved no canvas binary,
and importing pdf-parse threw 'DOMMatrix is not defined' — which used to
happen at boot, so the server could not start at all on those machines.
1.0.8 is the first line that ships win32-arm64-msvc. Verified: the override
resolves cleanly and pdf-parse's v2 getText() extracts text unchanged under
it, end to end through the lore loader.
Note it is a GLOBAL override, so it retargets pdfjs-dist too — the other
dependent, which asks for ^0.1.80 and is the code that actually consumes
the DOMMatrix/Path2D/ImageData surface. That is deliberate: scoping the
override to pdf-parse alone would resolve two different canvas copies, and
the ARM binary would be missing from the one that matters.
Revisit when pdf-parse bumps its own pin. Until then removing this
silently drops Windows-on-ARM support, and a canvas security update has to
be taken by hand. See src/server/util/pdf-text.ts.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && node scripts/audit-current-tree.mjs --dev-mode && node scripts/audit-security-contracts.mjs
